About NeoSculpt6

Led by Doctors, Not by Packages

Your A–Z Destination for Cosmetic & Aesthetic Care

At NeoSculpt6 you are not handed to a counsellor or a technician. Your concern is assessed, your plan is designed and your procedure is led by a senior specialist and the same doctor follows your recovery. Dermatology and plastic surgery, under one roof.

Founder & Lead Doctor

Dr Sandeep Mahapatra

Founder · Senior Consultant Dermatologist · Cosmetic Expert · Hair Transplant Surgeon

For more than two decades Dr Sandeep has treated hair loss, skin and ageing concerns as medical problems first and cosmetic ones second. He developed the Neo Follicle Transplant (NFT) approach to graft handling and implantation, has performed 10,000+ hair transplants, and has trained 18+ surgeons — with 55+ specialists formed under his guidance.

  • MBBS (honours, gold medals in two subjects)MGM Medical College, Jamshedpur
  • MD Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy (Gold Medalist)RIMS, Ranchi
  • Certified DHI SpecialistDHI Global, Greece
  • Basic and advanced Botox and dermal filler certificationAllergan

Real Results

Results ThatLook LikeYou.

We aim for results that suit your face and body, not a template. If you don't need a procedure or need to wait, we'll tell you. Every case is shared with the patient's written consent.

View Full Results Gallery

Individual results vary. Before-and-after images are shared for patient education and are not a promise of a specific outcome.

Diagnosis before surgeryEarly thinning often responds to PRP, GFC, exosomes or medication and you’ll be told so.
Neo Follicle Transplant (NFT)Dr Sandeep’s own approach to graft handling and implantation, refined over 10,000+ procedures.
DHI and FUE, chosen per caseMethods matched to your hair, scalp and goal, not to a brand name.
ARTAS robotic assistanceImage-guided robotic harvesting where your donor area suits it.
Repair and complex casesUnnatural hairlines, poor density and previous transplants elsewhere, assessed for correction.

Signature Expertise

Hair Restoration, Planned for the Next Ten Years

A hairline should still look natural when you are older. Dr Sandeep plans every transplant around your donor reserve and future hair loss not graft numbers.
